name: Common Origin design tokens
description: How the token sets and modes combine, in the DTCG 2025.10 Resolver format (decision 0032). config/style-dictionary.config.mjs builds tokens.json, tokens.ts and the :root block of tokens.css from the sets, and a [data-co-density] or [data-co-theme] block in tokens.css for each context.

density.description: Control heights, control insets and row heights for a region, set with data-co-density on any element (decisions 0032, 0034 and 0051). Layout spacing doesn't change.

theme.description: Light or dark colour for a region, set with data-co-theme on any element (decision 0054). Changes colour and shadow only. Each ramp step keeps its job, so the dark context overrides base colour values (generated by scripts/generate-palette.mjs) plus a few semantic exceptions. A product that doesn't set it stays light: tokens.css never follows prefers-color-scheme by itself (#358).
